class.name: OpenWorldTerrainLayer
class.brief_description: Material and generation metadata for an OpenWorldTerrain layer.
class.description: [OpenWorldTerrainLayer] groups the textures and metadata for one terrain surface layer. [member generation_role] separates natural height-generated layers, such as mountains, plains, and cliffs, from surface-only layers, such as roads and dirt paths, so future terrain generation can ignore layers that should not modify height.

members.member: Triplanar albedo texture used by this layer.
Ambient occlusion texture. The red channel is used by the built-in OpenWorldTerrain material.
Controls how future terrain generation should treat this layer.
Display name shown by editor layer painting controls.
If enabled, this layer can be mapped to the current material slots. In the current renderer, the first three enabled layers are mapped to low, mid, and high.
Triplanar normal texture used by this layer.
Parallax height texture used for material detail only. It does not modify terrain height data.
Fallback roughness used when [member roughness_texture] is unset.
Roughness texture. The red channel is used by the built-in OpenWorldTerrain material.
Semantic feature tag used by generation and editor tooling, such as mountain, plain, cliff, road, or dirt path.
Multiplier color applied to the albedo texture.

constants.constant: Natural terrain layer that can participate in height or biome generation, such as mountain, plain, or cliff.
Surface-only layer, such as road or dirt path, that should be excluded from height generation.
Manual or reserved layer ignored by automatic terrain generation.
Generic layer without a specific terrain feature role.
